                            <section data-hk="0000000100000000000200000590" id="methodology" data-section="methodology">
                                <!--$-->
                                <a data-hk="00000001000000000002000005910" data-component="section-bridge" href="#geo-breakdown">
                                    <span>LEARN MORE</span>
                                    <i></i>
                                    <strong>GEO BREAKDOWN</strong>
                                    <b>▸</b>
                                </a>
                                <!--/-->
                                <!--$-->
                                <h2 data-hk="000000010000000000020000059200" data-slot="section-title">
                                    <strong>
                                        <a data-slot="heading-link" href="#methodology">
                                            <span data-slot="heading-anchor" aria-hidden="true">#</span>
                                            <!--$-->
                                            Methodology
                                            <!--/-->
                                            <!--$-->
                                            .
                                            <!--/-->
                                        </a>
                                    </strong>
                                    <!--$-->
                                    <span data-hk="000000010000000000020000059201">How this data is collected.</span>
                                    <!--/-->
                                </h2>
                                <!--/-->
                                <dl data-component="methodology-list">
                                    <div data-hk="00000001000000000002000005930">
                                        <dt>Updates</dt>
                                        <dd>Aggregated every hour. Days and weeks use UTC.</dd>
                                    </div>
                                    <div data-hk="00000001000000000002000005931">
                                        <dt>Tokens</dt>
                                        <dd>Input, output, reasoning, and cached tokens for each request.</dd>
                                    </div>
                                    <div data-hk="00000001000000000002000005932">
                                        <dt>Users and sessions</dt>
                                        <dd>Approximate counts of distinct users and OpenCode sessions.</dd>
                                    </div>
                                    <div data-hk="00000001000000000002000005933">
                                        <dt>Cost</dt>
                                        <dd>Session cost is the average cost per OpenCode session. Token prices are list prices from the OpenCode model catalog.</dd>
                                    </div>
                                    <div data-hk="00000001000000000002000005934">
                                        <dt>Retention</dt>
                                        <dd>The share of a model's users in one week who use it again the next week.</dd>
                                    </div>
                                    <div data-hk="00000001000000000002000005935">
                                        <dt>Citation</dt>
                                        <dd>Cite OpenCode Data (opencode.ai/data) with the update time shown at the top of the page.</dd>
                                    </div>
                                </dl>
                            </section>
